decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That details submitted pursuant to condition 3 of planning permission 00745/192/P4, relating to materials, are unacceptable as the combination of red interlocking concrete tiles and red bricks provides insufficient contrast between the roof and walls and would harm the appearance of the area.

Condition : 2 - Informatives

On the basis of the samples provided the condition cannot be discharged. Specifically the red concrete interlocking roof tile is unsatisfactory. The brick and tile submitted would not relate well to each other and would harm the appearance of the house. The red roof tile would also not relate well to the adjacent property's roof (194A) and would serve to harm the appearance of the surrounding area. 

A black or grey roof tile accompanied by the submitted brick that would allow the new house to complement the area and would also serve to enhance its own appearance is recommended.
description: Following approval for erection of a detached 4 bedroom house with associated parking, vehicle access and landscaping - details submitted pursuant to Condition 3 (materials) of approved planning permission ref 00745/192/P4 dated 18/08/2005.
